questions: Should the x-values be sequential integers starting from 1, or should they correspond to the original positions of the shuffled y-values (i.e., the x-axis is just the index sequence)?
Are the x-values the same length as each inner list (i.e., 1,2,...,len(list_)), and the y-values are a permutation of those same numbers?
What should be plotted if an inner list contains non-numeric elements (e.g., strings)?
Is the shuffling applied to the original list elements, or to a generated sequence of numbers based on the list length?
Should the function set any plot title, axis labels, or other formatting?
How should the function handle an outer list that is empty? The clarification says 'assume it plots an empty graph (no lines)', but does it still return a valid (fig, ax) tuple with an empty plot?
Should the random seed be set within the function to ensure reproducibility, or rely on external setting as stated?
Are the colors in COLORS guaranteed to be valid matplotlib color specifiers, or should the function validate them?
